search.title: Advanced Bible search
search.books: Optional books (multiple selection; none means all)
search.help: Search does not change original text. Matching uses Unicode NFC and case folding; optional accent folding is explicit. Boolean syntax supports AND, OR, NOT, parentheses, quoted phrases and suffix *. Unknown private book labels are not guessed into a testament. Similar-word searches are lexical aids; they do not establish theological or philosophical equivalence.
search.partialCount: At least {total} matches for “{query}”. Search budget reached; narrow the scope.
search.cancelled: Search cancelled. Original text is unchanged.
search.noResults: No matches in the selected editions and scope.
search.historyFailed: Search is available, but its history entry could not be saved.
search.searchSaved: Search saved in your personal workspace.
search.selectionShortened: Only the first 200 characters were pre-filled. Review or edit the query before searching; the original selection is unchanged.
